title: ArchitectureDecisionRecord
description: Schema for an Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Captures the structured rationale for a technology or design decision including problem context, hard constraints, candidate options, evaluation criteria, scoring matrix, recommendation, and conditions under which the decision should be revisited.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the decision being recorded.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this ADR.

created_by.description: Identity of the person or agent that created this ADR.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this ADR was created.

problem_statement.description: Description of the problem or decision that needs to be made.

hard_constraints.description: Non-negotiable constraints that eliminate any option that does not satisfy them.

approved_candidates.description: Technology or design candidates that passed the hard constraint filter and are under evaluation.

decision_criteria.description: Criteria used to evaluate the candidates, each with a weight and its source.

criterion.description: Name or description of the evaluation criterion.

weight.description: Relative weight assigned to this criterion in the evaluation.

weight_source.description: Justification or reference for the weight assigned to this criterion.

evaluation_matrix.description: Scored evaluation of each candidate against the decision criteria.

candidate.description: Name of the candidate being evaluated.

scores.description: Map of criterion name to score value for this candidate.

recommendation.description: The recommended decision or selected candidate with justification.

alternatives_rejected.description: Candidates that were considered but rejected, with reasons.

trade_offs.description: Known trade-offs accepted as part of this decision.

conditions_that_change_decision.description: Conditions or events that would trigger a review or reversal of this decision.

human_approver.description: Identity of the human approver required to ratify this decision.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence sources that support this decision.
